scenes.name: Jimi Hendrix
scenes.book: Heavy Metal: The Music and Its Culture
scenes.author: Deena Weinstein
scenes.desc: Intérprete de la tradición del blues eléctrico que ya había incorporado buena parte del estilo psicodélico, incluido su gusto por lo visual. Murió antes de que el heavy fuese un género definido, pero influyó enormemente en su música y su puesta en escena por su carisma y su talento, y porque encarnaba a la vez las dos tradiciones sobre las que se levanta el género. Con Cream introduce en el blues rock elementos del jazz, sobre todo los solos instrumentales extensos.
scenes.family: Raíces: blues rock, psicodelia y hard rock

podcast.title: Influence on Metal and Rock
podcast.body: Phil Lynott, of Thin Lizzy, is cited as one of the "black guys" who metal music "owed a big debt" to in the 1980s, emphasizing the crucial but often overlooked contributions of black artists to the genre's history. "even though metal owed a big debt to black guys like Jimmy Hendrix and Phil Linatov, then Lizzie."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Manchester Origin
podcast.body: Phil Lynott is mentioned in a list of artists with a connection to Manchester, although the specific nature of his "groupy Manchester" connection is unclear in the transcript, it implies a significant presence or influence. "Phil Linnett, groupy Manchester."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Manchester Origins
podcast.body: Phil Lynott is listed among the numerous bands from Manchester, emphasizing the city's prolific musical output. "loads of loads of Aces, Buzcocs of Fall, James, Godly and Cream, Badly Drone Boy, Elbow, you know, John Mayl, Star Sailor-Verb, Phil Linnett, group of Manchester, Smith and you are a simply red, all his, you know, he goes on and on and this, this is bands and bands and bands, you know."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Influence on Metal and Rock
xref.body: Thin Lizzy, through its member Phil Lynott, is referenced to underscore the "big debt" that metal in the 1980s owed to black artists, acknowledging their significant contributions to rock and its subgenres. "Phil Linatov, then Lizzie."
